title: The Schema & Structured Data for WP & AMP WordPress plugin before 1.70 does not safely encode its structured data…
description: The Schema & Structured Data for WP & AMP WordPress plugin versions before 1.70 contain a vulnerability where structured data output is not safely encoded when the Pretty Print option is enabled. This flaw allows users with Contributor-level roles to perform stored cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks by mapping a schema property to a custom field.
